Also creates lightning bolts that hit random towers, stunning them. |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Wox The Fox Theme|center|250px|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Wox the Fox''', internally referred to as just '''Wox''', is the final boss of [[Pizza Party]]. '''Wox the Fox''' has a slow speed but a high amount of health. When the [[Lost Souls]] modifier is active, its health is increased by an additional 25,000. It is also immune to being frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], confused by the [[Jester]], knocked back, slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]] and damaged by the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. Additionally, it can only be slowed down by stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] instead of being stunned. '''Wox the Fox''' has four abilities: #Its first, ''Game Over'', makes it jumpscare the player, temporarily reducing the range of all towers by 50% through the [[Scared Debuff]] and deals 400 damage to units. Before this jumpscare, the screen will zoom in, and there will be a vignette around the screen. It only happens when '''Wox the Fox''' first spawns and reaches half health. #Its second, ''Birthday Surprise'', makes it take out a birthday cake and throw it into the air, which falls onto its hat, breaking into multiple smaller pieces. These pieces go up into the air and then fall down onto the map, which, upon landing, creates a shockwave that stuns any tower caught in it and deals 500 damage to units. #Its third, ''Coin Gun'', makes it shoot out multiple coins from its left mechanical hand at towers, which upon landing create shockwaves that stun any tower caught in them and deal 500 damage to units. #Its fourth, ''Melody Shock'', makes it play its guitar, creating a shockwave that stuns towers in a wide area. It also creates white lightning bolts, which also stun towers and deals 500 damage to units. ==Appearance== '''Wox the Fox''' is a large fox animatronic with its left arm replaced with a mechanical cannon. It has many parts making up its main body, with some parts being left barren, revealing '''Wox the Fox's''' endoskeleton. As it receives damage, it will start to slowly lose all its parts, exposing its endoskeleton entirely. '''Wox the Fox's''' body parts are colored blue and white, with its endoskeleton being grey. It wears a black top hat and tie. Its pupils also have a red outline. If [[Lost Souls]] is active, '''Wox the Fox''' will appear without its fur parts, instead spawning fully in its endoskeleton appearance. '''Wox the Fox''' has a death animation where it kneels forward, emit sparks, and then powers down. ==Strategy== *'''Wox the Fox''' cannot be slowed down by most towers. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] can only slow down '''Wox the Fox''' instead of stunning it. The [[Warden]] can also only slow it for a shorter amount of time due to its large size. **It is also immune to being frozen by the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]], due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. ***However, the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] can be useful against the enemies that appear before '''Wox the Fox'''. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow this down as it is immune to its slowing effect. It can, however, be useful against the enemies that appear before it. **The [[Jester]] cannot confuse '''Wox the Fox''', but it can slow it down with its ice bombs. *High DPS towers, such as [[Accelerator]]s, [[Turret]]s, [[Engineer]]s, [[Golden Minigunner]]s and [[Ranger]]s are recommended to defeat '''Wox the Fox'''. These towers should be boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]]. **The [[Ranger]] is immune to stuns from '''Wox the Fox's''' abilities, making it very useful against it. **If you are using the [[Gatling Gun]] against '''Wox the Fox''', you should note that it has a broken hitbox, meaning hitting most parts of its model in ''FPS'' mode will have the [[Gatling Gun]] not deal damage to it. To damage '''Wox the Fox''' in ''FPS'' mode consistently, you should aim at '''Wox the Fox's''' feet. **When dealing with '''Wox the Fox''' in a match with [[Lost Souls]] active, the [[Golden Minigunner]] is the most optimal tower against it. *Make sure to sell any [[Farm]]s to maximize the number of towers attacking '''Wox the Fox'''. They do not produce any income anymore, count towards your tower limit, and can be replaced by a more useful tower. **The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can still produce income, so you can keep them if you need more cash for your towers. However, this is generally not necessary, as you will get a lot of cash from damaging enemies and '''Wox the Fox''' itself. ***Because of this, you can also sell your [[Cowboy]]s or [[Golden Cowboy]]s at later waves, if you can place down any other high DPS towers. *The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to partially mitigate the effects of '''Wox the Fox's''' [[Scared Debuff]]. **It can also be useful for increasing your tower's range and decreasing its upgrade costs. **You can also try to replace your towers after the ''Game Over'' ability, though this is not necessary. *The [[Medic]] can be quite useful at shielding towers from stuns. **Do note that the [[Medic]]'s shild cannot be used to protect towers from the [[Scared Debuff]]. *Defense-dropping towers can be used to decrease '''Wox the Fox's''' defense when the [[Lost Souls]] modifier is active. However, due to you only being able to pick one tower of your choice to activate the [[Lost Souls]] modifier, this is not recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} WoxWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2022 – Present) WoxCake.gif|''Birthday Surprise'' animation (31 October 2022 – Present) WoxCoinShoot.gif|''Coin Gun'' animation (31 October 2022 – Present) WoxGuitar.gif|''Melody Shock'' animation (31 October 2022 – Present) WoxJumpscare.gif|''Game Over'' animation (31 October 2022 – Present) WoxFullDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (31 October 2022 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseWox.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, endoskeleton (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseWoxTheFoxNormal.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, normal (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TDSHalloween2022Thumbnail.png|'''Wox the Fox''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TDSHalloween2022Icon.png|'''Wox the Fox''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI5.jpg|'''Wox the Fox''' on a promotional image. PizzaPartyIconNew.png|'''Wox the Fox''' in the [[Pizza Party]] map icon }} ==Trivia== *'''Wox the Fox''' is heavily based on the animatronics from the ''Five Nights at Freddy's'' franchise, more specifically [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Foxy|Foxy]]. *For the [[Pizza Party]] mini rework in [[v1.50.0]], an idea that was considered was making '''Wox the Fox''' speed up as it lost parts of its body, though this did not make it into the actual game. *Due to a bug, [[Pizza Party]] matches may sometimes have more than four players, making it a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]].
